$comment: Known migration-to-generated-type drift. This is a ratchet: a baselined finding does not fail the static guard, a NEW finding does, and a baselined finding that no longer applies also fails until its entry is deleted. Regenerate with `bun run types:generate` once SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN is available, then delete every entry the regeneration fixes.
reason: Empty: regenerating against the live schema fixed all thirteen entries this ratchet held (crm_broadcasts, crm_contacts, data_points, events). A future finding must either be fixed the same way or baselined deliberately.
